findings.title: Direct LLM API calls in emergency alerts bypassing model router

evidence.observation: Direct invocations of call_gemini and call_mistral via environment variables bypassing centralized router policy

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM queries through the centralized model router endpoint

findings.expected_benefit: Unified telemetry, load balancing, cost tracking, and fallback handling
